title: Enrolment of Primary 1 Students Based on Distance and Parents' Ties with Schools
what_it_is: Enrolment of Primary 1 Students Based on Distance and Parents' Ties with Schools

sections.label: Primary 1 distance and ties
sections.summary: Under 15% of successful Phase 2A1 and 2A2 applicants stay over eight km away, and the framework prioritises home-school distance.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Out of all successful applicants at Phases 2A1 and 2A2 in the past three Primary 1 registration exercises, less than 15% stay more than eight kilometres (km) away from their schools.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: So, they form less than 2% of the total Primary 1 cohort.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: The current Primary 1 framework does recognise the need to consider school ties and home-school distance together, as priority is given to those who live within one km of the school, followed by those who live between one km and two km, and then only those who live more than two km from the school.

sections.label: Balancing school places and ties
sections.summary: The Ministry of Education is asked to review cases, and says it must balance proximity spaces with alma mater and sibling needs while tracking data.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Would there be any possibility for the Ministry of Education to review and look at all these cases?

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: There is always going to be a need to balance out the availability of spaces for proximity as well as to make sure that parents have some opportunity to send children to their alma mater or if the sibling is already in that school and the family has relocated.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: So, there is always going to be a balance that we have to strike between these varying needs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We will always be tracking the data around Primary 1 admission very, very carefully.
